title: Tech Note: 4D v11 SQL Maintenance and Security Center
author: Jason T. Slack, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the Maintenance and Security Center (MSC), introduced in 4D v11 SQL to consolidate the old About box, Open dialog, backup preferences, and the standalone 4D Tools application into a single interface for database maintenance (verify, backup, compact, rollback, restore, repair). The MSC concept and terminology described here (standard vs. maintenance mode, OPEN SECURITY CENTER command) persisted for many subsequent 4D versions, so the note is still conceptually useful, though the interface has been visually and functionally revised multiple times since 2007 and some described screens/behaviors may no longer match current 4D exactly.
related_updates: 4D's Maintenance and Security Center (MSC) has continued to evolve in later 4D versions with updated UI and features
4D Tools as a separate application was discontinued starting with 4D v11 SQL, its functionality folded into the MSC as this note describes
